mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with promethazine (anticholinergic antihistamine) increases risk of severe CNS depression, anticholinergic toxicity, and hypertensive crisis due to inhibition of monoamine metabolism and additive central effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use lowest promethazine dose with careful monitoring for CNS depression, hypertensive episodes, and anticholinergic symptoms; consider alternative antihistamines with less anticholinergic activity.
